1:00:00 Screen fades to black (audio continues)

1.8 Hz Delta monaural beats • Deep Sleep • 8 Hours • seamless, no ads mid-video.
Monaural beats blend two tones into one, creating the beat in the audio itself, so your brain follows it (the frequency-following response) on a speaker, both earbuds, or just one.
